name: ecommerce-seo-website-migration
description: Plan, map, QA and recover an e-commerce website migration for SEO. Never promises traffic preservation or invents results.

interface.shortDescription: SEO-safe e-commerce migrations, from URL map to recovery
interface.longDescription: Classify the migration, build the inventory and baseline, decide every legacy URL, verify redirects hop by hop, check links, indexing, canonicals, hreflang, products and tracking, hand off fixes with retest conditions, assess launch readiness and diagnose post-launch changes by mapped page group.
defaultPrompt: Plan our move to Shopify without losing organic traffic.
Our organic traffic dropped after the migration.
